comment: Not named: c31-secret-set-not-task-content.test.ts reads the S0-5 world's content list and opens no database. c31-audit-chain-corrupted.test.ts runs C31's audit-chain case over corrupted hashes, so it fails by design; vitest.config.ts collects it only inside a test worker, as the child c31-audit-chain-test-catches-corruption.test.ts spawns. That parent reaches the database only through its child, so the import scan cannot name it; it runs in every database run of tests/custody.
